---
applyTo: "app/**/*.vue"
---

# Vue component instructions

- Use Vue 3 Composition API with `<script setup lang="ts">`.
- Prefer Nuxt and Vue auto-imports.
- Prefer Nuxt UI before building replacement primitives.
- Keep props and emitted events typed.
- Preserve server rendering and static generation.
- Use semantic HTML and ensure keyboard accessibility.
- Use shared theme tokens instead of hard-coded brand colors.
- Avoid unnecessary client state and watchers.
